description: Get a derivatives market overview including aggregated open interest, 8-hour-equivalent funding rates, top coins by open interest (each top_coins_oi entry is an asset, its lot spellings included), and exchange/coin counts.
name: get_derivatives_overview

avg_funding_rate.description: Simple mean of the 8-hour-equivalent rate over each (venue, asset) primary contract with a fresh rate.

oi_excluded_venues.description: Venues left out of total_oi_usd, top_coins_oi and the open-interest funding weights, with the reason.

oi_weighted_funding_rate.description: The same primaries' rates, each weighted by its own contract's one-sided open interest. `null` when no primary carries open interest (nothing to weight by), never the simple mean.

coin.description: The asset's symbol. Every contract of the asset counts once, lot spellings included (PEPE sums Binance and Bybit 1000PEPEUSDT and Hyperliquid kPEPE); two assets sharing a ticker are two entries (CAT the stock, CAT the coin). While the instrument master is unavailable, the stored base coin.

total_oi_usd.description: The market-wide open interest GET /v1/global/overview publishes (metrics.openInterestUsd): one-sided USD over every crypto asset holding at least $100K plus the RWA perps, venues in oi_excluded_venues left out.

OpenInterestExclusion.description: A venue whose stored open interest is published per venue but left out of every cross-venue total, and why. MEXC today: its holdVol moves 7.00x the position change of MEXC's own deal feed, so it fits neither side count.

meta.description: Which route answered, what the API said about the data's freshness, and whether the client cut the answer to fit the agent's context window.

route.description: Always `v1`: every call reads the keyed /v1 route.

truncated.description: True when the answer is cut short: by the API's row budget, or by the client (`truncated_fields`).

truncated_fields.description: The arrays and strings the client cut, by JSON path in `data`: `total` items received, `showing` kept, `kept: latest` when an oldest-first series kept its newest items.

warnings.description: What the API or the client could not do, in words. State them with the answer.

pagination.description: Present when the answer is one page: pass `cursor` back to read the next one.

title: Market-wide derivatives overview
